question: What happens to coverage if the employee ceases active full-time employment?
expected_answer: Coverage terminates on the date the employee ceases active full-time employment.
evidence: 4.1 Your coverage terminates on the earliest of: (c) The date you cease active full-time employment

goal_plan.reasoning: The query asks about the consequences for coverage (likely health insurance or benefits coverage) when an employee stops active full-time employment. This is a policy-related question that depends on the specific rules of the employer’s benefits plan. However, the query does not mention any specific company, plan, or policy name, so it cannot be answered with a single lookup. Instead, the answer hinges on understanding general rules about employee benefits coverage termination upon cessation of full-time employment. The key concept here is the relationship between employment status and coverage eligibility. Since the query is general and not tied to a specific entity, the only way to answer it is by retrieving standard policy information about coverage continuation or termination under such circumstances. This is a single factual lookup: what typically happens to benefits coverage when full-time employment ends.

goals: the typical policy rule regarding employee benefits coverage upon cessation of active full-time employment

candidates.path_text: "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the last day of the month in which the individual ceases to be an eligible employee." -> (has ) -> [taylor family revocable trust (Contingent beneficiary)]
"The basic benefit is recalculated annually on the policy anniversary based on the individual's current salary." -> (has ) -> [policy anniversary (Annual review date for benefit adjustment)]

"Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the individual ceases active full-time employment." -> Termination of employment status ends eligibility, which may occur before the policy terminates. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the last day of the month in which the individual ceases to be an eligible employee." -> Coverage terminates upon the Master Policy's termination, which may occur before the individual ceases employment. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the Master Policy terminates."

"Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the individual ceases active full-time employment." -> Termination of employment status ends eligibility, which may occur before the policy terminates. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the last day of the month in which the individual ceases to be an eligible employee." -> Termination due to loss of employment eligibility allows conversion, even if the policy is still active. -> "If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may exercise a conversion privilege."

"Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the individual ceases active full-time employment." -> Termination of employment status ends eligibility, which may occur before the policy terminates. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the last day of the month in which the individual ceases to be an eligible employee." -> The master policy governs coverage termination when the employee ceases to be eligible. -> "The master policy number is AGB-2024-TC-GROUP."

"Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the individual ceases active full-time employment." -> Termination of employment status ends eligibility, which may occur before the policy terminates. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the last day of the month in which the individual ceases to be an eligible employee." -> Coverage termination upon ceasing employment aligns with the condition that total coverage is subject to eligibility and duration rules, which are tied to employment status. -> "Total coverage cannot exceed $1,000,000."

"Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the individual ceases active full-time employment." -> Ceasing active full-time employment may lead to voluntary coverage termination, which the individual can request. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the individual requests termination of voluntary coverage." -> Termination of coverage occurs when premiums are no longer paid, which may coincide with voluntary coverage termination. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the last day for which required premiums have been paid."

"Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the individual ceases active full-time employment." -> Ceasing active full-time employment may lead to voluntary coverage termination, which the individual can request. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the individual requests termination of voluntary coverage." -> Termination of voluntary coverage by request triggers the need to apply for conversion within 31 days. -> "The individual must apply for conversion within 31 days of termination of group coverage."

"Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the individual ceases active full-time employment." -> Termination due to cessation of full-time employment triggers the right to convert coverage. -> "If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may exercise a conversion privilege." -> Termination due to loss of employment eligibility allows conversion, even if the policy is still active. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the last day of the month in which the individual ceases to be an eligible employee."

"Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the individual ceases active full-time employment." -> Termination due to cessation of full-time employment triggers the right to convert coverage. -> "If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may exercise a conversion privilege." -> If coverage ends due to reasons other than non-payment, the individual may convert to an individual policy. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the Master Policy terminates."
